text.config.bctweaks.title: Beacon & Conduit Tweaks Config
text.config.bctweaks.option.beaconRangeP: Extra range for each block of this type in the pyramid. One entry per line, written as block_id=range, for example minecraft:diamond_block=0.5. Lines that are not in that form, or that name a minecraft: block that doesn't exist, are dropped when you save. Blocks from other mods are kept, and ignored (with a warning in the log) while that block isn't in the game.
text.config.bctweaks.option.conduitBaseR: A flat range every active conduit has, before frame bonuses.
text.config.bctweaks.option.conduitFrame: How many active frame blocks it takes to earn one step of range. Vanilla uses 7.
text.config.bctweaks.option.conduitRange: Range added for each full step of frame blocks. Vanilla uses 16, so a complete 42-block frame reaches 96.
text.config.bctweaks.option.conduitAddVa: Deprecated. Only used for the three conduit settings above that were never set in your config file: on gives vanilla's range per step (16), off gives none. Use Conduit Range / Step instead.
text.config.bctweaks.option.conduitRange: Range for each frame block of this type around a conduit. One entry per line, written as block_id=range, for example minecraft:diamond_block=4. Lines that are not in that form, or that name a minecraft: block that doesn't exist, are dropped when you save. Blocks from other mods are kept, and ignored (with a warning in the log) while that block isn't in the game. Listed blocks also count as conduit frame blocks.
